title: Policy compliance state monitoring
description: Tracks compliance state trends and identifies resources falling out of compliance over time.
example_prompt: "Show policy compliance summary for subscription '{subscription_name}'. Include: (1) total policies assigned, (2) compliant vs non-compliant resource count, (3) top 10 policies by non-compliance count, (4) resources that became non-compliant in the last 7 days. Show trend vs previous week."
